components.name: alert
components.title: Alert
components.summary: An inline message tied to a page or section. It communicates a status that persists until the condition changes or the user dismisses it.
whenToUse: A form or section-level error ("3 fields need attention").
A persistent warning about the current context ("This asset hasn't been scanned in 30 days").
A success message that should stay visible after a page change.
whenNotToUse: Transient feedback on an action → [Toast](./toast-tooltip.md).
Product-wide announcements at the top of the app → [Banner](./banner.md) (deprecated). Use a full-width Alert at the top of the layout instead.
Field-level errors → the field's `errorText`.

components.name: badge-tag
components.title: Badge · Tag
components.summary: A small pill that labels an object with a status (**Badge**) or a category (**Tag**). It's the same primitive; Badge shows a status dot by default.
whenToUse: **Badge:** the status of an item ("Active", "Failed", "Pending").
**Tag:** a classification or metadata ("Production", "API", "EU").
whenNotToUse: Vulnerability severity → [Severity Badge](./severity-badge.md), which has the canonical severity colours.
Counts on navigation or icons → a count bubble (see Filter Bar's `count`).
Anything clickable → a button or a filter pill ([Filter Bar](./filter-bar.md)).

components.name: banner
components.title: Banner
components.summary: A full-width strip at the top of the app for product-wide announcements, promotions or warnings.

components.name: breadcrumb
components.title: Breadcrumb
components.summary: Shows where the current page sits in the hierarchy and lets users jump back up.
whenToUse: Pages two or more levels deep (Assets / example.com / Finding #123).
whenNotToUse: Flat, top-level pages.
Showing step progress in a flow → a stepper.
Showing browsing history. Breadcrumbs reflect hierarchy, not history.

components.name: button
components.title: Button
components.summary: Buttons trigger an action on the current page: submitting a form, opening a modal, starting a scan.
whenToUse: To commit, start or confirm an action ("Start scan", "Save changes").
To open an overlay that belongs to the current page (modal, drawer).
whenNotToUse: To move to another page or URL. Use a link (`<a>` / Next `<Link>`) instead, even if it looks like a button. Assistive tech announces buttons and links differently.
For a toggle between two states. Use [Switch](./switch-radio.md).
For a choice between options. Use [Radio](./switch-radio.md), [Select](./select.md) or [Tabs](./tabs.md).

components.name: cards
components.title: Cards
components.summary: Dashboard cards that summarise a topic and lead to a next step. There are two presets: **InsightCard** (a key/value list) and **AlertCard** (an active-issue callout).
whenToUse: **InsightCard:** a compact summary of 3–6 metrics with an optional "view more" action.
**AlertCard:** highlighting active issues that need attention, with a count and a CTA.
whenNotToUse: Charts → [Chart](./chart.md) `ChartCard`.
Tabular records → [Data Table](./data-table.md).
A generic container. There's also `components/ui/card.tsx` (shadcn); see Known gaps.

members.name: as
members.description: Heading level for the document outline. Defaults to h3.

components.name: chart
components.title: Chart
components.summary: A dependency-free set of SVG chart primitives in a shared card shell: donut, bar, line and treemap, plus stat blocks.
whenNotToUse: A single bounded value → [Gauge](./gauge.md).
More than ~6 donut segments → use a bar chart.
Exact values users need to read or copy → [Data Table](./data-table.md).

DonutSegment.type: { label: string; value: number; color: string }

TreemapBlock.type: { label: string; value: number; color: string; textOn?: "accent" | "primary"; }

components.name: checkbox
components.title: Checkbox
components.summary: Lets the user turn an independent option on or off, or pick several items from a list.
whenToUse: Several independent choices ("Notify by email", "Notify by Slack").
Selecting rows in a table, including a "select all" header with an indeterminate state.
A single opt-in that takes effect on submit ("I accept the terms").
whenNotToUse: Mutually exclusive choices → [Radio](./switch-radio.md).
A setting that applies **immediately** → [Switch](./switch-radio.md).

components.name: data-table
components.title: Data Table
components.summary: A composable card that lists findings (threat, asset, date, severity) with a header, column headers, rows and a pagination footer.
whenToUse: Lists of findings or threats where users scan, compare and page through records.
whenNotToUse: Fewer than ~5 items with rich content → a list of [Cards](./cards.md).
Key/value details of one record → a description list.
Arbitrary columns. This table currently has a **fixed threat-row schema** (see Known gaps).

members.name: tooltip
members.default: "Shortcut info about the widget — typically explains what powers this data."

members.name: threatsTooltip
members.default: "Name of the detected threat, finding or CVE."

members.name: assetTooltip
members.default: "The domain, IP or service the threat was found on."

components.name: empty-state
components.title: Empty State
components.summary: Fills a region that has no content yet. It explains why it's empty and what to do next.
whenToUse: First use ("No assets yet"), no results ("No findings match these filters"), cleared state ("All caught up"), or a recoverable error ("Couldn't load findings").
whenNotToUse: Content is loading → [Skeleton](./skeleton.md).
A page-level failure with no recovery → an error page.

EmptyStateAction.type: { label: string; icon?: React.ComponentType<{ size?: number; className?: string }>; onClick?: () => void; }

components.name: filter-bar
components.title: Filter Bar
components.summary: A horizontal toolbar that combines search, filter pills and view actions above a table or list.
whenToUse: Above a [Data Table](./data-table.md) or list where users narrow the results by several dimensions.
whenNotToUse: One filter → just a [Select](./select.md) or [Search Bar](./search-bar.md).
Switching between unrelated views → [Tabs](./tabs.md).

components.name: gauge
components.title: Gauge
components.summary: A semicircular meter that shows a single value against a known maximum, such as a security score.
whenToUse: One headline value on a bounded scale (Security score 72 / 100, coverage %).
whenNotToUse: Comparing several values → a bar chart ([Chart](./chart.md)).
Values without a meaningful maximum → a big-number `StatBlock` ([Chart](./chart.md)).
Task progress over time → a progress bar.

components.name: modal
components.title: Modal
components.summary: A dialog that interrupts the current task to request a decision or focused input. It traps focus and blocks interaction with the rest of the page until it closes.
whenToUse: Confirming a destructive or irreversible action ("Delete 3 assets?").
A short, self-contained task that must finish before continuing (rename, quick create).
whenNotToUse: Long forms or multi-step flows → a dedicated page.
Non-blocking information → [Alert](./alert.md) or [Toast](./toast-tooltip.md).
Content users need to reference while working on the page → a drawer / side panel (not built yet).

components.name: search-bar
components.title: Search Bar
components.summary: A text input dedicated to searching or filtering content, with a search icon and a clear button.
whenToUse: Free-text search across a page, table or the whole product.
whenNotToUse: Form data entry → [Text Field](./text-field.md).
Combined with filter pills → use `FilterSearch` inside [Filter Bar](./filter-bar.md).
Global navigation search → the ⌘K command palette.

components.name: select
components.title: Select
components.summary: A single-choice dropdown that picks one value from a list of options.
whenToUse: One choice from 5–15 known options (severity, region, scan profile).
whenNotToUse: 2–4 options that should all be visible → [Radio](./switch-radio.md).
More than ~15 options, or the user needs to type to search → a searchable combobox (not built yet).
Several selections → a checkbox list or multi-select (not built yet).
Triggering actions (Edit, Delete) → a menu (not built yet), not a select.

SelectOption.type: { value: string; label: string; disabled?: boolean; }

components.name: severity-badge
components.title: Severity Badge
components.summary: The canonical way to show a finding's severity (Critical → Info), optionally with its numeric score (e.g. CVSS).
whenToUse: Any time a vulnerability, threat or finding's severity is shown: tables, cards, detail headers.
whenNotToUse: Generic statuses (Active, Failed) → [Badge](./badge-tag.md).
Aggregate severity charts → [Chart](./chart.md), which uses the same `snt-severity-*` palette.

components.name: skeleton
components.title: Skeleton
components.summary: A pulsing placeholder that mirrors the shape of content while it loads.
whenToUse: Loading cards, tables, lists or charts whose layout is known.
First load of a page section, to avoid layout shift (CLS).
whenNotToUse: Short inline waits or unknown layouts → [Spinner](./spinner.md).
Background refreshes of content that's already shown. Keep the stale content and show a subtle indicator instead.

components.name: spinner
components.title: Spinner
components.summary: An indeterminate loading indicator for short waits when the shape of the result is unknown.
whenToUse: Short waits (< ~3s) inside a button, a small panel, or an inline region.
When the content's layout isn't known in advance.
whenNotToUse: Loading a page or card whose layout is known → [Skeleton](./skeleton.md). It reduces perceived wait time and layout shift.
Long operations with measurable progress → a progress bar (not built yet).
Inside a Button → use `<Button loading>`, which renders its own spinner.

components.name: switch-radio
components.title: Switch · Radio
components.summary: **Switch** turns a single setting on or off, effective immediately. **Radio** picks exactly one option from a small, visible set.
whenToUse: **Switch:** a setting that applies the moment it changes ("Continuous scanning").
**Radio:** 2–5 mutually exclusive options that should all be visible for comparison.
whenNotToUse: A choice that only takes effect after "Save" → [Checkbox](./checkbox.md), not a Switch.
More than ~5 options → [Select](./select.md).
Multiple selections → [Checkbox](./checkbox.md).

components.name: tabs
components.title: Tabs
components.summary: Switches between related views of the same object without leaving the page.
whenToUse: 2–7 peer views of one entity (Overview · Findings · Assets · Settings).
The content of each tab makes sense on its own.
whenNotToUse: Sequential steps → a stepper (not built yet).
Navigating to different pages → navigation links (sidebar, breadcrumb).
Toggling a filter on one dataset → a segmented control or [Filter Bar](./filter-bar.md).
Comparing content side by side → users can't see two tabs at once.

members.name: variant
members.description: underline (default): page-level sections. pill: compact segmented control.

members.name: count
members.description: Optional count chip after the label (e.g. open findings).

components.name: text-field
components.title: Text Field
components.summary: A single-line input for short free text: names, domains, IPs, emails.
whenToUse: The answer is one line and can't be picked from a known list.
whenNotToUse: Multi-line text → [Textarea](./textarea.md).
A choice from a known list → [Select](./select.md) (5+ options) or [Radio](./switch-radio.md) (2–5 options).
Searching or filtering a list → [Search Bar](./search-bar.md).

components.name: text-space
components.title: Text Space
components.summary: A rich-text composer (toolbar + writing area) for formatted notes, reports and comments.
whenToUse: Long-form content that needs formatting: remediation notes, report summaries, comments with lists or links.
whenNotToUse: Plain multi-line text → [Textarea](./textarea.md).
Single-line input → [Text Field](./text-field.md).

members.name: active
members.description: Pressed state of toggle commands, keyed by execCommand name.

members.name: onCommand
members.description: Called after a command runs (TextSpace uses it to sync value + state).

members.name: label
members.description: Accessible name for the editing area. Use `aria-labelledby` for a visible label.

members.name: defaultValue
members.description: Initial HTML. The editor is uncontrolled — read changes via onChange.

components.name: textarea
components.title: Textarea
components.summary: A multi-line plain-text input for notes, descriptions and justifications.
whenToUse: The answer may need more than one sentence (scan notes, exception justification).
whenNotToUse: One-line answers → [Text Field](./text-field.md).
Formatted text (bold, lists) → [Text Space](./text-space.md).

components.name: toast-tooltip
components.title: Toast · Tooltip
components.summary: **Toast** is a brief, non-blocking confirmation of something that just happened. **Tooltip** is a short label or hint that appears on hover or focus of a control.
whenToUse: **Toast:** confirming the result of a user action ("Scan started", "Report exported").
**Tooltip:** naming an icon-only button, or giving a one-line definition of a term.
whenNotToUse: Errors that block progress, or anything the user must act on → [Alert](./alert.md) or [Modal](./modal.md). Toasts disappear.
System-wide announcements → [Banner](./banner.md) / [Alert](./alert.md).
Essential information, or interactive content (links, buttons) → not a tooltip. Use inline text or a popover.
Disabled controls → tooltips can't be reached on disabled elements (Atlassian guidance).

members.name: duration
members.description: Length of the countdown bar in ms (matches auto-dismiss in ToastProvider).

members.name: paused
members.description: Freezes the countdown bar (hover / focus in ToastProvider).

members.name: duration
members.description: Auto-dismiss delay in ms. Default 4000; failures default to 8000.

members.name: open
members.description: Force the bubble open (docs / screenshots). Omit for hover + focus behaviour.

members.name: delay
members.description: Hover delay in ms before showing.
